newsitem.title: USA: NAPM - New York business conditions 61.9 in January.
newsitem.headline: NAPM - New York business conditions 61.9 in January.

text.p: The National Association of Purchasing Management (NAPM) index of New York-area business conditions fell to 61.9 in January from 72.9 in December.
"Growth in both the non-manufacturing and the manufacturing sectors of the regional economy settled back in January," said a report issued with the index.
The New York-area non-manufacturing conditions index slipped to 62.8 in January from 74.4 the month before.
Manufacturing-sector conditions fell to 53.9 from 59.1, the lowest reading since April 1996, the report said.
An index above 50 denotes growth, NAPM said.
NAPM's New York business outlook index, which looks ahead about six months, read 71.7 in January, just above the 71.6 registerd in December."
"Looking forward to the upcoming six months, purchasers' optimisim remained high in January," NAPM said.
